HomePage.heading: Show timers on your product pages
HomePage.body: Add the Timer block to your product page in the theme editor. It shows the countdown timer that applies to each product, and hides itself when none is running.

steps.add: Select Add to product page, then save the theme editor.
steps.move: Drag the block to where it fits best, such as above the Add to cart button.
steps.create: Create a countdown timer and choose the products it applies to.

errors.startDateRequired: Enter a start date, or clear the start time.
